reviews.comment: Nice guy but hard class. Lots of group projects and presentations, roughly 1 per week. You have to do lots of reading with difficult text (research papers). He does give partial credit on his test but it's not easy. Class actually requires critical thinking, be prepared to get called on. You only have him for half the semester then switch to Yust.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework
